csv_project_name: Engineering service for Fair Avenue Sidewalk Construction
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Yakima is inviting Statements of Qualifications (SOQ) from firms interested in providing professional engineering design, survey, and preparation of required environmental documentation for the following grant-funded Washington State Transportation Improvement Board project: Fair Avenue Multimodal Improvements. Work will include PS&E for the construction of new sidewalk on the west side of the roadway on Fair Avenue between Nob Hill Blvd and Pacific Avenue, providing for driveway approaches and meeting all ADA and other state and federal requirements. Work will include determining right-of-way needs and preparing right-of-way maps. Work will also include updating stormwater facilities for surface water treatment to meet current local, state and federal water quality requirements.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Analytical/Testing Services, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Water Quality Testing, Traffic Design Engineering
